source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Classify a motion as oscillatory when it moves to and fro about a fixed position.

intelligence.enrichment: When an object moves to and fro about some fixed position, its motion is called oscillatory motion. to-and-fro motion about a fixed position -> oscillatory motion classification The learner correctly applies this rule: When an object moves to and fro about some fixed position, its motion is called oscillatory motion. Oscillatory motion means any motion that repeats, including circular motion.
